ghiChu: Cau hinh may doc duoc de tai tao pipeline anh AI (Qwen-Image-2512 + Qwen-Image-Edit-2511). Gia tri lay tu VM thuc te ngay 2026-10-01 (gcloud describe, nvidia-smi, pip freeze, ~/hf/*/.cache) va tu script da chay. Muc 'chuaKiemChung' liet ke cho chi suy ra, khong co ghi chep lenh goc.

bootDisk.lyDo: 150 GB day 100% (con 1.2 GB). Qwen-Image-2512 54 GB + Edit-2511 39 GB + LoRA 1.6 GB + venv 5.3 GB + he thong ~18 GB = ~118 GB, chua tinh ban chep PNG/log va cap nhat kernel (dkms can cho trong).

gcp.giaSpotGhiChu: Gia do chu du an cung cap (A100 spot, uoc luong, chua gom dia). pd-ssd tinh them theo GB-thang ke ca khi VM tat.
gcp.quota: can quota GPU A100 (preemptible/spot) >= 1 trong region us-central1

stockout.cachXuLy: thu start lai moi ~3 phut, toi da ~30-60 phut roi doi zone

gcp.watchdog: sudo shutdown -h +90 (gia han moi ~5 phut khi con giam sat) hoac +45 khi chi chep tai nguyen

cuDaCoSan: cuda-toolkit-12-4 (cuda-keyring_1.1) - khong can cho PyTorch wheel, la di san cua benchmark LLM truoc
gpuDriver.chuaKiemChung: Lenh apt cai driver khong duoc ghi lai; README.md muc 2 dung lai tu dpkg -l

maySuCucBo.luuY: dat PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 khi in tieng Viet tren Windows

models.vaiTro: anh tu vung / canh (vocab, scene, ban goc nhan vat)
models.dungLuong: 54 GB (text_encoder 4 shard ~16.6 GB, transformer 9 shard ~41 GB, vae 0.25 GB)

models.vaiTro: bien the bieu cam nhan vat (image edit)
models.tai: chi transformer (5 shard ~41 GB) + processor + scheduler + model_index.json; text_encoder, tokenizer, vae la symlink sang ~/hf/Qwen-Image-2512/
models.luuY: khong xoa Qwen-Image-2512/{text_encoder,tokenizer,vae} neu con dung Edit

loras.cachDung: load_lora_weights + fuse_lora(lora_scale=1.0) + unload_lora_weights; scheduler FlowMatchEulerDiscrete cau hinh Lightning (exponential time shift, base_shift = max_shift = ln 3)

loras.dungCho: Qwen-Image-2512 che do 'light' (chi dung khi thu, KHONG dung o ban cuoi)
loras.revision: khong ghi lai (da xoa khoi VM)

vocabVaCanh.cfgGhiChu: true_cfg_scale = 4.0 (co negative prompt). gen.py mac dinh --steps 50 cho mode base, nen PHAI truyen --steps 20 --cfg 4

taoLai.ketQua: 99 chon s22, 42 chon s33, 18 giu SVG cu

vocabVaCanh.nap: pipeline len CPU ~4 phut, ma hoa prompt bang text encoder tren GPU roi giai phong, transformer bf16 + vae len GPU

nhanVatGoc.ghiChu: 17 nhan vat con lai da co anh chan dung tu truoc; tong 28 (prompts/nhan-vat/ids28.json)

bieuCam.anhDieuKienGhiChu: 384*384 pixel, lam tron boi 32, dua vao text encoder qua pipe.image_processor.resize
bieuCam.negativeMacDinh: chi dung khi cfg > 1 (that su khong dung vi cfg = 1): text, symbols, sweat drops, sparkles, open mouth, teeth, white dots, speckles, sticker outline, different clothes

inbox.tepJob: {out, steps, cfg, size, jobs:[{ten, ref, prompt, seed}]}
inbox.uuTien: ten tep bat dau bang 'p-' chay truoc

lamNen.script: vm/lam-nen.py (chay o may local, can numpy + scipy + pillow)
lamNen.luuY: KHONG dua ma hex vao prompt; mau nen chi duoc ep sau khi sinh

kiemTra.tuDong: tools/qa/tu-dong.py: gan-nhu-trong >97% nen; vung-toi-lon >4%; nghi-the-khung vung sang >18%; nghi-khung-chu-nhat >=3 canh thang; nghi-o-vuong lap >90% bbox va >15% anh; nen-chua-phang

dauRa.vocab: assets/minh-hoa/*.webp (1261 tep) + tools/minh_hoa_chi_muc.json (id -> ten, cap, webp, trangThai, nguon)
dauRa.nhanVat: assets/minh-hoa/nv/<id>/<khoa>.webp (28 x 8) + assets/minh-hoa/nv/chi-muc.json; chan dung goc assets/minh-hoa/nv-<id>.webp
dauRa.gan: tools/gan_anh.py (chay lai sau moi lan build lai curriculum)

uocTinhLanChayDaQua.tongGhiChu: GPU thuan sinh anh, chua gom thu style, nap model, cho doi va dia

chiPhi.diaPdSsdUsdMoiGbThang: ~0.17 (theo bang gia cong khai, chua doi chieu); 200 GB ~ 34 USD/thang ke ca khi VM tat
chiPhi.khuyenNghi: xoa VM va dia khi khong dung; tao lai theo README mat ~25-30 phut truoc anh dau tien (~1 USD)

chuaKiemChung: Lenh apt cai driver NVIDIA that su da dung (chi co ket qua dpkg).
Co --accelerator trong lenh create: A2 gan san A100 theo machine type, neu gcloud bao trung thi bo co nay.
